      "observations": [
        "Public original/fixed source sorts a new array by ascending severity, parsed start timestamp and percent chance. Date.parse compares equivalent timestamp spellings by value. Current-candidate retention is a separate guard: an eligible equally or more important current candidate remains even if other ranking keys differ. Reuse the existing ranking/displacement distinction.",
        "Before replacing a candidate, current updatedNotifications cancels the existing timer, handles no-candidate state, then checks the six-entry rolling history. Rescheduling waits oldest timestamp+time unit-Date.now and returns; updater separately uses its24-entry history. The REQUEST_NOTIFICATIONS_EVENT refreshes filtered cached candidates through InAppNotifications rather than directly making a server request.",
        "Every new non-null selected candidate contributes to in-memory manager history before visible/non-UI handling. The display-oriented documentation is therefore narrower than actual selection accounting. History is not the persisted interactedWith list and is not established as a restart-persistent daily bound.",
        "Source exposes instance _MAX_MS_BETWEEN_NOTIFICATIONS and static _PER_TIME_UNIT; actual receivers govern. Existing scoped receiver lesson reused, with no change to any general static/preference rule. The bounded negative-event test uses a1s wait with an explicit local lint exception, then checks10–14s rescheduling bounds; it does not authorize arbitrary delays elsewhere.",
        "Retained current test proposals remain proposals: input-preservation fixture uses tied keys, and two start-date/composite test task functions share the test_sortByStartAt display name.
